"""Text truncation for previews."""

import re

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    # Consider only text that fits in the budget, including a boundary char right after it.
    window = text[: budget + 1]
    if window[-1:].isspace():
        candidate = window[:-1]
    else:
        # Drop the partial word at the end, keeping everything up to the last whitespace.
        m = None
        for m in re.finditer(r"\s", window):
            pass
        candidate = window[: m.start()] if m else ""
    candidate = candidate.rstrip()
    if not candidate:
        # No whole word fits; fall back to a hard cut so the limit is still respected.
        candidate = text[:budget]
    return candidate + ELLIPSIS
EOF

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents stripped to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

"""Text truncation for previews."""

import re

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    # Only look at text that fits in the budget, plus the character right after it
    # (if that is whitespace, the word before it is complete).
    window = text[: budget + 1]
    if window[-1:].isspace():
        candidate = window[:-1]
    else:
        # Drop the partial word at the end: keep everything before the last whitespace.
        starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"\s", window)]
        candidate = window[: starts[-1]] if starts else ""
    candidate = candidate.rstrip()
    if not candidate:
        # No whole word fits; fall back to a hard cut so the limit is still respected.
        candidate = text[:budget]
    return candidate + ELLIPSIS

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents stripped to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

"""Text truncation for previews."""

import re

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    # Only look at text that fits in the budget, plus the character right after it
    # (if that is whitespace, the word before it is complete).
    window = text[: budget + 1]
    if window[-1:].isspace():
        candidate = window[:-1]
    else:
        # Drop the partial word at the end: keep everything before the last whitespace.
        starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"\s", window)]
        candidate = window[: starts[-1]] if starts else ""
    candidate = candidate.rstrip()
    if not candidate:
        # No whole word fits; fall back to a hard cut so the limit is still respected.
        candidate = text[:budget]
    return candidate + ELLIPSIS
